csv.filename_description: Commodity daily ASK and BID CSVs laid out as <COMMODITY>/YYYY/MM/DD/DD.MM.YYYY_(ASK|BID)_OHLCV.csv. Scanner aggregates per symbol and exposes ASK/BID/MID entries (MID synthesised at ingest). Required columns: timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume. ASK files carry ask_vwap and BID files carry bid_vwap; both are loaded as optional columns and preserved through to the returned dataframe (MID frames carry both).
